summary: The Loudoun Education Foundation Board of Trustees urges the FCC to keep the E‑Rate program unchanged, opposing any narrowing of eligibility—particularly a geographic restriction to rural areas—and requests that both Category 1 and Category 2 services remain funded.

claims.requested_action: do not limit eligibility on a geographic basis
claims.argument: A geographic test would arbitrarily split a single school division, funding some schools and not others despite shared networks and tax bases.
